name: Cheval Blanc Paris
description: With an iconic setting in the much-loved Samaritaine building, this 1st Arrondissement hotel is a tribute to French savoir-faire and craftsmanship. Take a short stroll one way and get to the Cathedral of Notre Dame, walk the other way and arrive at the Eiffel Tower, and pop around the corner to find the Louvre. The hotel has just 72 rooms, providing a discreet and exclusive escape in the heart of the city. Bite into a warm croissant just out of the oven, sink into the foam of a delicately scented bath, and capture the soul of Paris from your winter garden.
